#include "atax.h"

void kernel_atax(double A[38][42], double x[42], double y[42], double tmp[38]) {
    int i, j;

    // Initialize tmp vector to zero
    for (i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
        tmp[i] = 0.0;
    }

    // First matrix-vector multiplication: tmp = A * x
    for (i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < 42; j++) {
            tmp[i] += A[i][j] * x[j];
        }
    }

    // Initialize output vector y to zero
    for (i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
        y[i] = 0.0;
    }

    // Second matrix-vector multiplication: y = A^T * tmp
    for (i = 0; i < 42; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < 38; j++) {
            y[i] += A[j][i] * tmp[j];
        }
    }
}
